nadia: Postmortem follow-up: the delayed-job backlog returned. Need a short playbook appendix: immediate triage, exact commands, escalation chain, and owners. Prefer small PRs.

eric: I'll take alerts & canary: lower lag threshold to 400, add 5m canary check. ETA 48h.

sara: I'll draft the runbook appendix: detect query, safe restart steps, and escalation template. PR by Mon noon.

adia: paste the quick SQL we used to confirm backlog please.

eric: SQL: ```sql
SELECT topic, partition, lag FROM consumer_offsets WHERE topic='delayed-jobs' ORDER BY lag DESC;
```

sara: safe restart we used: ```bash
kubectl rollout restart deployment/delayed-jobs-worker -n prod
# if pod stuck: kubectl delete pod <pod> -n prod --grace-period=0 --force
```

adia: escalation path: oncall -> eng-sre -> platform lead (pager). Add paging template.

oncall-bot: Escalation template ready: "INCIDENT: delayed-jobs backlog; repeated restarts x2; need eng-sre"

eric: added a log grep for OOMs: ```bash
kubectl logs <pod> -n prod --since=1h | grep -i oom
```

adia: owners recap: sara runbook PR (Mon noon), eric alerts/canary (48h). I'll attach to ticket RW-3744 and schedule follow-up.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: runbook/delayed-jobs -> staging (sha: c3d4e5)

adia: thanks. If anyone needs more time update RW-3744 and mention here."
